global.conclusion: All point estimates are positive, but all CIs cross zero and month-stability gates failed. No candidate is promoted.

broad_pre_race_diagnostic_slices.interpretation: All three candidates deteriorated versus market, but CIs still include zero. Strongest common weakness signal; not proof.
All three candidates were negative in small fields while the market baseline was comparatively concentrated/accurate. Candidate adjustment may add noise; not a causal conclusion.
All three candidates were negative when no horse had a strong market share. This is consistent with difficulty in diffuse/uncertain races, but is exploratory.
Broad common negative point estimate. Because distance can proxy race-class/composition, do not create a distance filter from this posthoc result.
All three point estimates are negative, but sample is small and uncertainty is large. Diagnostic only.

non_promotable_positive_diagnostics.note: These are recorded to prevent selective reporting, but must not be turned into a betting filter.

mechanistic_read: v4 and v5 depend on historical horse information, so history-sparse/newcomer races are a plausible structural weakness rather than an arbitrary subgroup.
v3 uses only market-path information yet also deteriorates in newcomer and diffuse-market slices, suggesting that uncertainty is not solved merely by short-horizon odds movement.
Small fields show a common negative point estimate while market favorite hit rate is relatively high; extra model adjustment may be unnecessary in some concentrated races.
The 1800-2199m signal may be composition confounding and is not treated as a distance effect without prospective confirmation.

decision.reason: Repeated adjacent-model instability already identified; do not proliferate another variant before timing/data provenance bottleneck is resolved.
next: Keep A_MARKET_ONLY as the public forward baseline role; v3-v5 remain SHADOW diagnostics, not promoted models.
Attach fixed pre-race shadow diagnostic tags to OrePro forward races without changing race selection, tickets, or stake.
After sufficient forward races, test whether the predeclared weakness tags reproduce before using them to motivate a new DEV hypothesis.
